Salary uncertainty (Monte Carlo)
The band on the chart shows where 80% of salary trajectories land given this spread. Set higher for volatile fields (startups, abroad); lower for stable ones (govt, academia).

How the engine works now

Each path runs three parallel futures — Dream, Base, and Worst — each with its own starting salary, growth rate, and probability weight. Those weights must sum to 100%. Career income in each scenario is probability-weighted against the fallback salary, then discounted to today's money. The expected value is the probability-weighted average across all three scenarios. Monte Carlo runs 300 trials sampling the base growth rate from a normal distribution centred on your input, with the spread you set — the chart band shows where the 10th to 90th percentile of outcomes land. Non-financial returns and family strain are reported separately and never priced into the rupees.

All figures are illustrative and yours to change. Presets are reasonable Indian starting points, not forecasts.
